Each row includes citation_id (stable; same as id), citation_body_hash, citation_version, status (SENT | EDITED | DELETED), edited_at / deleted_at, author identity/display name/user id, channel (CHAT | SMS), created_provider_timestamp (immutable pagination order; page with before set to the last returned id), provider_timestamp, and media metadata. Cite with citation_id plus hash/version — do not treat a DELETED or superseded body as current. Chat members and gig managers only. Uses the authenticated user Clerk backend auth; never mints or returns a Twilio token.

tools_if_shown.name: post_event_chat_message
tools_if_shown.description: Post a message to an event group chat as the authenticated user (not a separate bot identity). Notifies other members via the normal Twilio/SMS path. Returns the stored message row (same fields as list_event_chat_messages). Chat members and gig managers only. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: list_event_assignees
tools_if_shown.description: List the org members assigned to MANAGE a gig, with the scoped roles each holds (LEAD, STAFFING, TASKS, RUN_OF_SHOW, FINANCES). LEAD implies all the others. These are managerial grants, not the crew working the show — use list_event_members for the roster.

tools_if_shown.name: set_event_assignee
tools_if_shown.description: Assign an org member to manage a gig with a scoped role set. REPLACES the whole set: pass every role the person should hold, not just the new ones. LEAD implies all the others. Requires an org gig manager or a LEAD assignee on the gig. Rejected on template events.

tools_if_shown.name: remove_event_assignee
tools_if_shown.description: Remove every management role an org member holds on a gig. Idempotent — removing someone who is not assigned succeeds. Does not remove them from the crew roster.

tools_if_shown.name: my_agenda
tools_if_shown.description: List the authenticated user's events across all their organizations (defaults to ACTIVE). Answers 'what's on my schedule'. Tool name `my_agenda` is kept for agent compatibility; verb-noun aliases such as get_my_agenda are not registered separately to avoid breaking existing callers.

tools_if_shown.name: my_pending_actions
tools_if_shown.description: Aggregate actionable pending event invitations, crew offers (including standby), and availability requests for the authenticated user. Excludes settled responses, expired or terminal requests, and gigs whose last local day has passed. Answers 'what do I need to respond to?'. Tool name `my_pending_actions` is kept for agent compatibility; verb-noun aliases such as list_my_pending_actions are not registered separately to avoid breaking existing callers.

tools_if_shown.name: get_org_brief
tools_if_shown.description: Load a compact, one-call snapshot of an organization to ground org-wide work: the org profile, its crew positions, its venues, its ACTIVE events ordered nearest first (including today and ongoing gigs in their event/organization timezone), and its team. Defaults to your active organization. Read-only — sections you cannot access are listed under `unavailable`.

tools_if_shown.name: get_org_attention
tools_if_shown.description: Scan an organization for what may need attention, in one call: `upcoming_events` (ACTIVE, nearest first, including today and ongoing gigs in their event/organization timezone) and `pending_actions` (invitations, crew offers, availability requests awaiting YOU). Defaults to your active org. Read-only.

tools_if_shown.name: get_attention_items
tools_if_shown.description: List what needs an org owner's or admin's attention on upcoming gigs (next 30 days): deterministic findings where something changed and is still unfinished — call times changed after crew were notified, crew dropped off with shifts still open, a guest-count change with open tasks, billing terms changed with an unpaid receivable, or staffing short close to the gig. Each item has a classification (BLOCKING, NEEDS_ATTENTION, WATCH, FYI), a deterministic `reason`, the gig, affected people/records, and `evidence` records (kind + id + summary + timestamp) to cite as provenance, plus a navigation-only `suggested_action`. Sorted most urgent first. Owner/admin only; defaults to your active org. Read-only — resolve anything through the existing confirm-gated tools.

tools_if_shown.name: get_org_playbook
tools_if_shown.description: Read an organization's CheckAI agent playbook — the saved free-text rules/preferences the agent should follow for this org. Returns {organization_id, agent_playbook}. Defaults to your active org. get_org_agent_profile returns this playbook too, alongside the org's curated knowledge. Read-only.

tools_if_shown.name: get_event_settlement_status
tools_if_shown.description: Check whether an event is ready to be settled. Returns settled, unsettled_count, and unsettled_item_ids. Read-only. Call before settle_event.

tools_if_shown.name: list_organizations
tools_if_shown.description: List organizations the authenticated user is a member of.

tools_if_shown.name: get_organization
tools_if_shown.description: Get a single organization by id. tour_term is the org's own word for a tour ({ singular, plural, source }): band/dj orgs say Tour, venues Series, everyone else Project unless the org set its own. Use that word when talking to the user about tours; tool and field names (tour_id, list_tours) keep saying tour.

tools_if_shown.name: list_org_positions
tools_if_shown.description: List the position roster (instruments, roles) for an organization. Each row includes is_active. Defaults to active positions only so deactivated roles (Guitar, Bass, etc.) are not offered for staffing. Pass active_only=false to include deactivated roles. organization_id defaults to your active organization. source="defaults" instead lists Soundcheck's built-in position catalog (FOH Engineer, Stage Manager, Guitar, …) grouped by section: use a returned id as default_position_id in create_org_position to enable that role; roles not in the catalog are created with custom_name.

tools_if_shown.name: list_offerings
tools_if_shown.description: List the offering catalog for an organization — what the org sells on a show (dry rentals, crew day rates, production packages, venue services). Each row carries sell_rate, cogs, margin_pct, unit, category and how many invoice templates use it. Defaults to active offerings only; pass include_inactive=true to include retired ones. view="templates" instead lists the invoice templates: each carries its ordered offering lines (quantity, rate override, effective rate, amount, cost) and totals (subtotal, estimated cost, gross margin, margin %, deposit due, balance). organization_id defaults to your active organization. Offerings is a beta feature: for an organization or user it is not enabled for, this returns 404.

tools_if_shown.name: list_setlists
tools_if_shown.description: List setlists for an organization, or pass event_id to get only the setlists attached to that gig. Paginated with limit (max 100, default 20) and offset; event_id ignores pagination. organization_id defaults to your active organization. For an organization on Run of Show (setlists brought over), this returns a read-only projection of the Run of Show set items: one setlist per gig, whose id is the gig id.

tools_if_shown.name: list_songs
tools_if_shown.description: List songs in the organization library. Paginated with limit (max 100, default 20) and offset. organization_id defaults to your active organization (you must be a member of that org). Use after delete_song to verify the song was removed from the library.

tools_if_shown.name: get_setlist
tools_if_shown.description: Get a single setlist by id, including its sets and songs. For an organization on Run of Show (setlists brought over), this returns a read-only projection of the Run of Show set items: one setlist per gig, whose id is the gig id.

tools_if_shown.name: list_venues
tools_if_shown.description: List venues for an organization. By default returns only org-saved venues (excludes rows unlinked by delete_venue). Pass saved_only=false to search the shared global directory (includes unsaved rows with is_saved_for_org=false). Pass search to match venue name (substring, case-insensitive). Paginated with limit (max 100, default 20) and offset. organization_id defaults to your active organization.

tools_if_shown.name: get_venue
tools_if_shown.description: Get a single venue by id. organization_id is required by the API and defaults to your active org. Its bookable stages or rooms are listed by list_venue_stages with venue_id. view="enrichment" instead reads the latest venue research proposal from enrich_venue without running new research: available (whether research is configured) and run (null when the venue has not been researched).

tools_if_shown.name: list_customers
tools_if_shown.description: List customers (clients/contacts) for an organization. Pass search to match customer name (substring, case-insensitive). Paginated with limit (max 100, default 20) and offset. organization_id defaults to your active organization.

tools_if_shown.name: get_customer
tools_if_shown.description: Get a single customer by id within an organization.

tools_if_shown.name: list_sponsors
tools_if_shown.description: List sponsors for an organization.

tools_if_shown.name: list_inventory
tools_if_shown.description: List inventory items (equipment, stock) for an organization. Pass search to match name, category, or location (substring, case-insensitive). Paginated with limit (max 100, default 20) and offset. organization_id defaults to your active organization. assigned_quantity and available_quantity are as of today in the org timezone. committed_quantity sums active assignments covering today or future days; upcoming_quantity is the subset starting after today, including member and kit assignments. These totals can exceed stock across non-overlapping bookings; do not subtract them from quantity to calculate availability. For a gig's dates use check_inventory_availability with event_id.

tools_if_shown.name: get_inventory
tools_if_shown.description: Get a single inventory item by id, including active assignments. assigned_quantity and available_quantity are as of today in the org timezone. committed_quantity sums active assignments covering today or future days; upcoming_quantity is the subset starting after today, including member and kit assignments. These totals can exceed stock across non-overlapping bookings; do not subtract them from quantity to calculate availability. For a gig's dates use check_inventory_availability with event_id.

tools_if_shown.name: check_inventory_availability
tools_if_shown.description: Check whether inventory is free over a range of civil days (YYYY-MM-DD). Per item it returns the capacity, the peak number booked in the range, what is available, any shortage and the bookings that overlap. Pass event_id to use a gig's own dates and see what that gig has booked. Omit item_ids to check every item; an empty item_ids list checks none.

tools_if_shown.name: list_leads
tools_if_shown.description: List booking/staffing leads for an organization. Filter by status (pending/completed), pipeline stage (NEW/QUALIFIED/QUOTED/WON/LOST), owner, or search (case-insensitive substring on name, email, company, or location). Paginated with limit (max 100, default 20) and offset. organization_id defaults to your active organization.

tools_if_shown.name: get_lead
tools_if_shown.description: Get a single lead by id, including owner and converted customer when present. view="activity" instead lists the activity on the lead (claims, stage changes, notes, conversion), paginated with limit and offset. organization_id defaults to your active organization; pass it explicitly for a lead that belongs to another organization you are a member of (e.g. one returned by list_leads with organization_id).

tools_if_shown.name: list_calllists
tools_if_shown.description: List call lists / calllists (named rosters of members) for an organization, oldest first with a stable id tie-breaker. Paginated: limit defaults to 20 (maximum 100); offset defaults to 0.

tools_if_shown.name: get_calllist
tools_if_shown.description: Get a single calllist by id, including its members, position slots and labor call lines.

tools_if_shown.name: get_event_schedule
tools_if_shown.description: Get the schedule items (timeline) for an event.

tools_if_shown.name: get_event_checklist
tools_if_shown.description: Get the checklist (open items, completed items) for an event.

tools_if_shown.name: get_event_ledger
tools_if_shown.description: List an event's financial ledger items — payables, receivables, income, and expenses — each with type, status, amount, and counterparty. Read-only. Visibility is scoped server-side: regular members see only items involving them; org admins/owners see the full ledger. Each item also has paid_amount, remaining_amount and payment_status: status stays UNPAID until a line is fully paid, so read payment_status (partial when some is paid) and remaining_amount for a partly paid line. Use an item's id with record_ledger_payment to log a payment made outside Soundcheck, or reverse_ledger_payment to undo one.

tools_if_shown.name: list_notifications
tools_if_shown.description: List the authenticated user's own sent-notification delivery records, optionally filtered by event, channel type (SMS/EMAIL), or status.

tools_if_shown.name: list_imports
tools_if_shown.description: List recent import jobs for an organization (status, target type, source, row counts).

tools_if_shown.name: get_import
tools_if_shown.description: Get the full record for one import job, including its current status, mapping, and summary once previewed or committed.

tools_if_shown.name: get_import_field_catalog
tools_if_shown.description: Get the UEF field catalog for an import target type — canonical fields you can map columns to. Pass the SAME target_type as the import job (EVENT, LEAD, INVENTORY, or MEMBER); defaults to EVENT.

tools_if_shown.name: get_user_availability
tools_if_shown.description: Get a user's availability blocks within an organization, optionally filtered to a from/to date range. Defaults to the authenticated user and their active org.

tools_if_shown.name: get_availability_request
tools_if_shown.description: Get a single availability request by id. scope=received reads it as a recipient: the recipients list is filtered to you, and a request you were not sent returns 404. scope=organization reads it as the organization's manager, with every recipient and their replies; it needs crm.manage in that organization, so use it to read back a request you created (including a DRAFT). With scope omitted: passing organization_id means organization; otherwise the recipient view is tried first and, when it returns 404, the request is read from your active organization instead.

tools_if_shown.name: list_availability_requests
tools_if_shown.description: List availability requests. scope=received lists the requests sent to you (user_id defaults to you); status filters on YOUR reply: PENDING, AVAILABLE, UNAVAILABLE, EXPIRED, WITHDRAWN. scope=organization lists every request an organization created, including drafts; it needs crm.manage there, takes organization_id (defaults to your active organization) and event_id, and status filters on the request itself: DRAFT, OPEN, CLOSED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED. With scope omitted: user_id means received; organization_id, event_id, or a status only a request has (DRAFT, OPEN, CLOSED, CANCELLED) means organization; otherwise received. A status or filter that does not belong to the chosen scope is rejected rather than ignored.

tools_if_shown.name: respond_to_invitation
tools_if_shown.description: Accept or decline a gig invitation sent to the authenticated user. Idempotent: answering the same way twice is a no-op.

tools_if_shown.name: archive_event
tools_if_shown.description: Archive an event (sets event_status=ARCHIVED). Idempotent. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: create_event
tools_if_shown.description: Create a new event in an organization. By default the event is ACTIVE (published) as soon as it is created: crew can see it, and invitations added to it go out normally. Pass draft=true to create it as a DRAFT instead, as the web and mobile apps do: a draft is hidden from crew and holds its invitations until someone publishes it in the web app (MCP cannot publish). Ask the user which they want when it is unclear. The authenticated user is added as a member by default (pass member_ids to override, including [] to skip). For a multi-day gig pass end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, after event_date) and no start_time or end_time: a multi-day gig carries dates only, and passing times with one is refused. Per-day times belong in the run of show or on each shift. start_time and end_time are for single-day gigs and optional. Returns the new event id and resolved members.

tools_if_shown.name: complete_event
tools_if_shown.description: Mark a past, ACTIVE event as COMPLETED — the first closeout step. Consequential: when the confirmation gate is on, the first call returns confirmation_required + a token.

tools_if_shown.name: settle_event
tools_if_shown.description: Mark a COMPLETED event as SETTLED — the final closeout step. Check get_event_settlement_status first. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: reopen_event
tools_if_shown.description: Reopen a closed-out event to ACTIVE or COMPLETED to correct a premature closeout. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: update_org_settings
tools_if_shown.description: Change organization settings; pass only the ones to change. timezone: the IANA zone (e.g. America/Chicago) that new events inherit when create_event omits one — without it, events can stay on UTC. tour_term_singular / tour_term_plural: what the org calls a tour in the app (e.g. Season, Residency, Run); an empty singular goes back to the business-type default (band/dj Tour, venue Series, everyone else Project) and the plural is derived when omitted; only the user-facing word changes. playbook: the CheckAI agent playbook, which REPLACES the saved rules in full (empty string clears it). Requires org-admin (ADMIN/OWNER). Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: get_event_audit_logs
tools_if_shown.description: Get audit log entries for an event (changes to status, members, invitations, etc.).

tools_if_shown.name: list_mailbox
tools_if_shown.description: List the organization's mailbox threads (invitations, crew offers, availability requests, agreements). Priority-first: open threads come before history. Requires CRM-manager access. For INVITATION threads the mailbox id is the event id — call list_event_invitations with that event_id to get invitation ids before get_invitation or send_reminder kind=invitation. Crew-offer and availability-request ids can be used directly.

tools_if_shown.name: get_mailbox_check
tools_if_shown.description: Get the org mailbox unread cursor: last_checked_at and how many threads are new since then. Requires CRM-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: mark_mailbox_checked
tools_if_shown.description: Mark the org mailbox as checked now (clears the new-thread count until more replies arrive). Requires CRM-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: get_invitation
tools_if_shown.description: Read one invitation (recipient, status, event, timestamps). invitation_id is the invitation row id from list_event_invitations — not the mailbox thread id (that id is the event).

tools_if_shown.name: list_event_invitations
tools_if_shown.description: List invitation rows for one event (invitation id, recipient, status, delivery). Use the event_id from a list_mailbox INVITATION thread, then pass those invitation ids to get_invitation or send_reminder kind=invitation.

tools_if_shown.name: list_org_members
tools_if_shown.description: List organization members with roles and positions. Richer than list_users. Requires org membership. Paginated (default 50, max 200).

tools_if_shown.name: list_event_members
tools_if_shown.description: List the members on a gig roster as {event_id, members:[...]} (id, username, org role, position, call order, invitation_status, is_gig_creator). Convenience over get_event. When the gig creator is on the roster, their row has is_gig_creator=true and usually invitation_status=INVITED — that is the default roster status for anyone added directly, not an unanswered invite. The creator is not always on the roster (a gig created with member_ids: [] or a creator later removed has no creator row), so check the members list rather than assuming. Staffing responses live on invitations and crew offers.

tools_if_shown.name: preview_event_recipients
tools_if_shown.description: Resolve an event's roster into who would be messaged and on which channel, WITHOUT sending. Returns each member (user_id, name, has_phone, has_email, broadcast_eligible — no raw contact details) and a summary (total, sms_reachable, email_reachable, broadcast_total, broadcast_blocked). broadcast_eligible is true for the members broadcast_event_reminder will message, so declined and standby members are false, and broadcast_total counts the true ones. On a DRAFT or TEMPLATE gig, or for a caller who cannot send reminders on the gig, broadcast_eligible is null on every member and broadcast_total is null; broadcast_blocked says unpublished or not_authorized. Use this before send_message / broadcast_event_reminder.

tools_if_shown.name: list_ingestion_batches
tools_if_shown.description: List recent file-ingestion batches for an event (status, file counts, merge state).

tools_if_shown.name: get_ingestion_batch
tools_if_shown.description: Get one ingestion batch. view="status" (default): per-file analysis status plus the batch's merge state. Terminal file statuses: READY_FOR_REVIEW, ATTACHED_ONLY, COMMITTED, COMMITTED_VIA_BATCH, DISMISSED, FAILED. merge_status READY means the merged review is available. Analysis is asynchronous — check status ONCE; do NOT poll. view="review": the merged review payload — cross-file merged proposals, proposed_targets (UEF vs INGESTION classification), field_map (filled vs blank catalog paths), dry-run preview, key_facts, warnings, out_of_range_paths (run-of-show rows outside the gig dates), per-file sources, and merge_version (echo it back on commit_ingestion_batch). Proposals are UEF 2.0: commit rows by their document path.

tools_if_shown.name: get_ingestion_file_review
tools_if_shown.description: Get one ingested file's full review payload: extracted proposals, proposed_targets (UEF vs INGESTION classification), field_map (filled vs blank catalog paths), dry-run preview, key_facts, and out_of_range_paths (document paths of run-of-show rows outside the gig dates). Proposals are UEF 2.0: commit rows by their document path. Nothing has been written yet.

tools_if_shown.name: request_attachment_upload
tools_if_shown.description: Ask the HOST APPLICATION to upload the user's staged file attachments into an ingestion batch. For in-product hosts (Soundcheck web/mobile) with staged attachments — call this exactly ONCE after create_ingestion_batch when the user shared files, then STOP; the host uploads directly. Third-party MCP agents without a host uploader should use add_ingestion_file (content_base64 for a binary file, text for pasted text) instead.

tools_if_shown.name: respond_to_crew_offer
tools_if_shown.description: Accept or decline a crew offer (shift) sent to the authenticated user. Find offers with list_crew_offers (scope mine). Idempotent: answering the same way twice is a no-op.

tools_if_shown.name: unarchive_event
tools_if_shown.description: Unarchive an event (sets event_status=UNARCHIVED, which the app treats like ACTIVE). list_events with event_status=ACTIVE does not return it — omit the filter or pass UNARCHIVED. Idempotent. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: update_event
tools_if_shown.description: Update only the event fields you provide; an omitted field is left as stored. title takes precedence over its name alias; empty notes or location clears that field. end_date (YYYY-MM-DD) is the last day of a multi-day gig and must be on or after event_date; pass end_date: null to make the gig single-day again. start_time and end_time apply to single-day gigs. A multi-day gig carries dates only: setting times on one is refused (set per-day times in the run of show or on each shift), and an older multi-day gig that still has times can only have them cleared with start_time: null and end_time: null (clearing either clears both). Extending a timed single-day gig with end_date clears its times automatically. Whenever times are cleared that way, crew shifts that inherited them keep them as their own call times, and an empty run of show gets one section per day starting at the old start time. When event_date or end_date moves and no times are given, any stored local clock times move with it. Shortening the range onto days that still have accepted or pending crew is refused with the affected days named; resolve those crew first or finish in the web app. Confirmation-gated when the call sets or clears event_date, end_date, start_time or end_time, or sets a non-empty location, because the API then sends the gig's invited crew a schedule-change notification: the first call writes nothing and returns confirmation_required with a summary; show it to the user and, once they approve, resend the same arguments plus confirmation_token. Edits to only title, name, notes, or clearing location with an empty string are not gated. Concurrent edits to different fields are preserved; edits to the same field are last-write-wins. Use dedicated event lifecycle tools to change status.

tools_if_shown.name: publish_event
tools_if_shown.description: Publish a DRAFT gig by setting event_status to ACTIVE through the same API used by the app. Makes it visible to crew and sends its unsent PENDING invitations; backups remain STANDBY. Requires organization gig-management access. An already ACTIVE gig is returned without another write or send. Other statuses are refused; use the dedicated lifecycle tools. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Verify invitation delivery with list_event_invitations: ACTIVE alone does not prove every notification was delivered.

tools_if_shown.name: duplicate_event
tools_if_shown.description: Duplicate an event, optionally overriding the new event's title, notes, and date/times. The copy is ACTIVE unless target_state is DRAFT, and a template source always becomes a DRAFT. Copied invitations are unsent: on an ACTIVE copy send them with send_event_invitations; on a DRAFT copy they go out when the gig is published with publish_event or the Soundcheck app. Requires gig-operations access. Returns the new event.

tools_if_shown.name: add_event_member
tools_if_shown.description: Add one or more members (by user id) to an event, optionally staffing them in a role. Pass org_position_id from list_org_positions (active positions only). Each person lands on the gig roster as an EventMember with status INVITED and no Invitation row is created, so there is no accept/decline invite step. On a published (ACTIVE) gig the show pass treats them as confirmed/working and the owner pending-invite count stays 0; discovery uses EventMember ties. This does not send SMS or email invitations. On a published gig, they are added to the Google Calendar invite; draft and template gigs defer calendar invites until publish. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Requires gig-operations access. Returns the updated event.

tools_if_shown.name: link_venue_to_event
tools_if_shown.description: Link an existing venue to an event. The venue must already be saved to the organization's venue directory. Changing a gig's venue removes its stage bookings (stages belong to one venue); rebook with set_event_stages. Requires gig-operations access.

tools_if_shown.name: create_setlist
tools_if_shown.description: Create a setlist in an organization, optionally attaching it to an event. Pass sets to include songs on create (each song id must come from create_song), or add songs later via update_setlist. Setlists are retired for organizations on Run of Show: the API answers 409 SETLISTS_RETIRED, and sets are edited in the Setlist view of the gig Run of Show instead.

tools_if_shown.name: delete_setlist
tools_if_shown.description: Delete a setlist. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Setlists are retired for organizations on Run of Show: the API answers 409 SETLISTS_RETIRED, and sets are edited in the Setlist view of the gig Run of Show instead.

tools_if_shown.name: create_calllist
tools_if_shown.description: Create a call list (a reusable "team template") in an organization. Prefer positions[] — it carries seats per slot, and a slot needs no member, so a template can describe a crew SHAPE before anyone is picked. org_position_ids is the older flat form and cannot express seats. Pass members to pencil people in (user_id from list_users). Pass labor_lines to save a house labor call (per department: load-in/show/load-out call times and hands) that applying the template writes onto the gig labor call.

tools_if_shown.name: duplicate_calllist
tools_if_shown.description: Copy a call list — its category, position slots (with seats), labor call lines and roster — into a new template in the same organization. Defaults the copy to "<name> (copy)". The copy is never a Soundcheck starter, even when the source was one.

tools_if_shown.name: create_song
tools_if_shown.description: Create a song in the organization library (title required). Returns the song id for use in update_setlist.

tools_if_shown.name: delete_song
tools_if_shown.description: Delete a song from the organization library. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: update_setlist
tools_if_shown.description: Replace a setlist title and/or sets (full replace of sets when provided). Each song in sets[].songs must reference an existing library song id from create_song. Title is required by the API. Setlists are retired for organizations on Run of Show: the API answers 409 SETLISTS_RETIRED, and sets are edited in the Setlist view of the gig Run of Show instead.

tools_if_shown.name: update_calllist
tools_if_shown.description: Update a call list name/description/category and upsert members by user_id (existing org users). Pass members with user_id to add; set delete:true to remove. Name is required. Position slots are only rewritten when you send positions[] (preferred) or org_position_ids — omit both and the existing slots and seats are left untouched. labor_lines works the same way: sent replaces the template labor call, omitted leaves it alone.

tools_if_shown.name: update_checklist_task
tools_if_shown.description: Update one checklist task (status/title/notes/etc). Requires checklist_version from get_event_checklist (optimistic concurrency / If-Match). Status values: NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETE (not COMPLETED). Pass "" for notes, due_date, or assignee_org_member_id to clear them.

tools_if_shown.name: apply_calllist_to_event
tools_if_shown.description: Drop a call list onto a gig as DRAFT shifts (mode=draft_shifts, the default): one draft shift per position slot, covering every day of the gig, sized at max(seats, assigned members), with the people penciled into the template attached as un-sent draft recipients. NOTHING IS SENT AND NOBODY IS NOTIFIED — the admin reviews the roster and sets fees, then sends the offers. Re-applying is a no-op for slots this template already put on the gig (DRAFT/OPEN/FILLED); withdrawn or expired shifts leave a hole a re-apply refills. Both modes also add each template labor call line whose department the gig does not already have (case-insensitive) to the gig labor call, which writes its house labor shifts; labor_departments_added counts them. Returns shifts_created / recipients_added / skipped, plus a `hint` explaining why when 0 shifts were created (no org positions, template members without a position, empty slots, or already applied). mode=event_members is the legacy path: it adds roster rows instead of shifts, primaries (call_order 0) INVITED and backups STANDBY, and puts nothing on the Staffing board. Either mode commits people from the template onto a real gig, so it is confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: set_availability
tools_if_shown.description: Create an availability block for the authenticated user (e.g. 'unavailable next Tuesday 6–10pm'). type is AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE (case-insensitive; stored uppercase). Returns the created availability entry.

tools_if_shown.name: create_availability_request
tools_if_shown.description: Create an availability request in an organization (requires scheduler/CRM-manager access). request_mode defaults to TIME_WINDOW (requires start_time and end_time); use request_mode=DAY for a date-only request. If you pass recipient_ids the request is created AND sent after confirmation. Omit recipients to create an unsent request (status DRAFT). Pass event_id when the request is for a gig: its time zone sets the clock times shown in the response (event_timezone); without one they fall back to the organization time zone, which may be UTC. Read the request back with get_availability_request scope=organization, or list_availability_requests scope=organization.

tools_if_shown.name: send_availability_request
tools_if_shown.description: Send (dispatch) an existing availability request to its recipients, optionally adding more recipients first. The confirmation token binds the people who will be notified and the request details they will see (title, dates, times), so editing the request or its recipients after approval re-gates the send. Requires scheduler/CRM-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: respond_to_availability_request
tools_if_shown.description: Respond to an availability request as the authenticated user. status must be AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE.

tools_if_shown.name: create_venue
tools_if_shown.description: Create a venue in the organization's directory. Requires gig-operations/CRM-manager access. Returns the created venue.

tools_if_shown.name: delete_venue
tools_if_shown.description: Remove a venue from the organization's directory (unlinks the org overlay; the shared venue record remains). Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: delete_customer
tools_if_shown.description: Delete a customer (client/contact) from an organization. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: link_customer_to_event
tools_if_shown.description: Link a saved customer (client) to a gig so they appear as the event client in Soundcheck and the client portal. Requires CRM manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: unlink_customer_from_event
tools_if_shown.description: Remove a customer link from a gig. The customer record stays in the org directory. Requires CRM manager access. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: invite_customer_contact_to_portal
tools_if_shown.description: Email a customer contact a link to sign in to the Soundcheck client portal for this organization. Requires the client-portal entitlement and CRM manager access. Writes to a real person. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: create_lead
tools_if_shown.description: Create a booking/staffing lead in an organization. Requires name, email, event_date, event_type, location, and source (WEBSITE|REFERRAL|INBOUND_EMAIL|PARTNER|REPEAT_CLIENT|OTHER — staff-authored leads must state where they came from). Returns the created lead.

tools_if_shown.name: update_lead
tools_if_shown.description: Update a lead (partial merge). organization_id defaults to your active organization; pass it explicitly for a lead in another organization you belong to. Stage may be NEW, QUALIFIED, or QUOTED — use convert_lead, mark_lead_lost, or reopen_lead to reach Won or Lost. Pass null for event_id or customer_id to unlink.

tools_if_shown.name: delete_lead
tools_if_shown.description: Delete a lead. organization_id defaults to your active organization; pass it explicitly for a lead in another organization you belong to. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: set_lead_owner
tools_if_shown.description: Assign or clear the owner of a lead. Omit org_member_id to claim the lead yourself; pass an org member id to assign someone else (CRM manager; the owner must be active staff, any role except Member). Pass org_member_id null to remove the owner so the lead shows as Unassigned (CRM manager).

tools_if_shown.name: mark_lead_lost
tools_if_shown.description: Mark a lead as lost. Requires a reason. Use reopen_lead to bring it back.

tools_if_shown.name: reopen_lead
tools_if_shown.description: Reopen a lost lead into NEW, QUALIFIED, or QUOTED. Cannot reopen a converted (Won) lead.

tools_if_shown.name: convert_lead
tools_if_shown.description: Convert a lead into a customer on an event and mark the lead Won. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: create_inventory
tools_if_shown.description: Create an inventory item (equipment, stock) in an organization. Requires gig-operations/CRM-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: update_inventory
tools_if_shown.description: Update an inventory item (partial merge: omitted fields stay, null clears a text field or rate). Requires gig-operations/CRM-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: delete_inventory
tools_if_shown.description: Delete an inventory item. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: assign_inventory
tools_if_shown.description: Check out inventory to a gig or org member. Requires quantity and either event_id or org_member_id. Read get_inventory after assigning: committed_quantity includes current and future assignments; upcoming_quantity counts assignments starting after today. assigned_quantity and available_quantity remain as of today in the org timezone. For date-specific availability use check_inventory_availability with event_id.

tools_if_shown.name: return_inventory
tools_if_shown.description: Mark an inventory assignment as returned.

tools_if_shown.name: create_import_from_paste
tools_if_shown.description: Create an import job from pasted CSV/TSV text and parse it. Next call map_import, then preview_import, then commit_import. target_type must be EVENT, LEAD, INVENTORY, or MEMBER.

tools_if_shown.name: preview_event_from_url
tools_if_shown.description: Read a public event page (Luma, Partiful, Eventbrite, Meetup, a client brief, any event link) and return the gig fields it states: title, date, start/end time, venue, address and a short summary in notes, plus the sections it found: run_of_show (agenda items), doors_time, venue (with matched_venue_id), organizer (with matched_client_id), links, requirements (what to bring), capacity, ticket_price and suggested_gig_type. No gig is changed; what was read is kept with the link. Shows existing_event_id when this link was imported before. Review the fields and sections with the user, then call import_event_from_url with the sections they keep.

tools_if_shown.name: import_event_from_url
tools_if_shown.description: Save an event link as a gig. A new link creates a DRAFT gig; a link imported before updates that same gig and keeps its status. Pass the event fields from preview_event_from_url, edited as the user asked, and only the preview sections the user kept: run_of_show is written to the gig run of show, venue is linked, organizer becomes a show contact, requirements become tasks, links become gig links (with the event page), image_url becomes the gig cover, capacity fills an empty guest count, suggested_gig_type sets the gig type. title and event_date are required.

tools_if_shown.name: map_import
tools_if_shown.description: Resolve the column→field mapping for an import job. Call with NO mapping to let the server auto-map. Once correct, call preview_import before commit_import.

tools_if_shown.name: preview_import
tools_if_shown.description: Dry-run an import job (no data is written). Returns a summary of new vs updated rows and errors. ALWAYS preview before committing.

tools_if_shown.name: commit_import
tools_if_shown.description: Commit an import job — WRITES the data into the live system. Not reversible from here. Requires preview first. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: export_workspace
tools_if_shown.description: Download the active org workspace as one UEF 2.0 document (members, clients, venues, inventory, songs, setlists, projects, gigs with their days and shifts, leads; the same data as the Settings → Data zip). Pass the document to import_file on a destination org you manage. Does not include lead budgets, inventory replacement costs, crew performance fees, files, branding, or integration tokens.

tools_if_shown.name: preview_import_file
tools_if_shown.description: Dry-run a Soundcheck import file (a UEF 2.0 document) against a destination org you manage (no data is written). Pass the document from export_workspace, or one you built (get_import_format has the shape; check_import_file checks it). Inspect new vs updated counts and errors before import_file.

tools_if_shown.name: import_file
tools_if_shown.description: Import a Soundcheck import file (a UEF 2.0 document) into a destination org you manage — WRITES its records into the live system. Preview first with preview_import_file. Team members in the document may be emailed org invitations. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Dest org must be one you own or manage; not available on public MCP.

tools_if_shown.name: send_reminder
tools_if_shown.description: Send a reminder to people who have not answered yet. kind="invitation" reminds one pending gig invitation recipient by email (invitation_id; needs gig-manager access). kind="crew_offer" reminds pending recipients on an OPEN crew offer (offer_id). kind="availability_request" reminds pending recipients on an OPEN availability check (request_id; needs scheduler access). Optional message is prepended to the reminder. Writes to real people. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: invite_org_member
tools_if_shown.description: Invite someone to the organization by email. Clerk sends the email. Default role is org:member; org:gig_coordinator is allowed; org:admin and org:finance are owner-only. Writes to a real person. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Requires admin access.

tools_if_shown.name: send_message
tools_if_shown.description: Send a custom SMS or email to a specific list of ORG MEMBERS by user_id (NOT the whole roster — use broadcast_event_reminder for that). Writes to real people and is not reversible. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Set expected_recipient_count to the number of recipients.

tools_if_shown.name: broadcast_event_reminder
tools_if_shown.description: Send the standard event reminder to the members of an event's roster (SMS and/or email). Declined and standby members are not reminded, and DRAFT or TEMPLATE gigs are refused. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Set expected_recipient_count to preview_event_recipients summary.broadcast_total.

tools_if_shown.name: create_ingestion_batch
tools_if_shown.description: Create an empty file-ingestion batch on an event. Add files via add_ingestion_file (content_base64 for a binary file or text for pasted text, from third-party MCP agents) or request_attachment_upload (host-staged attachments in Soundcheck web/mobile).

tools_if_shown.name: add_ingestion_file
tools_if_shown.description: Add one source to an ingestion batch. Pass text for pasted TEXT (an email thread, itinerary, notes, a schedule), or filename plus content_base64 for a binary file (PDF, image, spreadsheet) — max 8 MiB decoded, which fits the hosted MCP 12 MiB JSON body after base64. Returns 202 and analysis runs asynchronously. Not for tabular CSV imports. Prefer request_attachment_upload when the host app can upload staged attachments.

tools_if_shown.name: trigger_ingestion_merge
tools_if_shown.description: Trigger (or re-trigger) the batch's cross-file merged analysis. CHECK merge_status on get_ingestion_batch FIRST — only trigger when merge_status is NONE, STALE, FAILED, or DISMISSED.

tools_if_shown.name: dismiss_ingestion_merge
tools_if_shown.description: Dismiss the batch's merged proposal. The per-file reviews stay available — use this to fall back to committing file by file.

tools_if_shown.name: retry_ingestion_file
tools_if_shown.description: Retry analysis for a FAILED or stalled ingested file. Returns 202 — analysis re-runs asynchronously.

tools_if_shown.name: dismiss_ingestion_file
tools_if_shown.description: Dismiss one ingested file's proposals — nothing from it will be committed. The file itself stays attached to the event.

tools_if_shown.name: commit_ingestion_file
tools_if_shown.description: Commit the selected proposals from ONE ingested file onto the event — WRITES live data. Not reversible. Always call get_ingestion_file_review first and pass the rows to commit as selected: their UEF 2.0 document paths in the review's proposals ($.events[0].days[d].run_of_show[c], $.events[0].shifts[s].crew[k], $.events[0].ledger_items[i], $.leads[l]). Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: commit_ingestion_batch
tools_if_shown.description: Commit the selected proposals from the batch's MERGED review onto the event — WRITES live data. Always call get_ingestion_batch with view=review first; merge_version must match. Pass the rows to commit as selected: their UEF 2.0 document paths in the review's proposals ($.events[0].days[d].run_of_show[c], $.events[0].shifts[s].crew[k], $.events[0].ledger_items[i], $.leads[l]). Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: create_event_invitations
tools_if_shown.description: Invite people to a specific gig (event-scoped — NOT org membership; use invite_org_member for that). Each invitation names an org member by user_id (IN_APP) or an external person by email (EMAIL) or phone_number (SMS), optionally with org_position_id from list_org_positions, call_order (0 primary, 1+ backup), and a performance_fee. On an ACTIVE gig the person is notified immediately by email/SMS/push by default; pass send_invitation=false to store unsent drafts and send them later with send_event_invitations. On a DRAFT gig every invitation is held unsent until the gig is published with publish_event or the Soundcheck app, whatever send_invitation says, so do not tell the user anyone was notified. Gig coordinators may only invite existing members by user_id. Pass invitations:[{"email":"sam@example.com"}] (or the emails:["sam@example.com"] shorthand); this tool is event-scoped and takes no organization_id. Writes to real people, so it is confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Verify with list_event_invitations.

tools_if_shown.name: send_event_invitations
tools_if_shown.description: Send a gig's unsent (draft) invitations — the ones created with send_invitation=false — by email/SMS/push. Pass invitation_ids from list_event_invitations to send a subset, or omit the field entirely to send every unsent invitation on the event — those are resolved when you call and the confirmation token binds exactly that list, so a draft added afterwards needs its own approval (an empty list is rejected, never treated as send-all). Already-sent invitations are not re-sent (use send_reminder kind=invitation for that). The event must be ACTIVE: on a DRAFT gig nothing is sent and results comes back empty, because invitations go out when the gig is published with publish_event or the Soundcheck app — never report them as sent. Messages real people, so it is confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: create_org_position
tools_if_shown.description: Add a position (role) to the organization roster so staffing, call lists, and crew offers have something to bind to. Enable a catalog role with default_position_id (from list_org_positions source=defaults) OR create a custom one with custom_name (+ optional custom_section). Optional default_day_rate seeds fees; display_order orders the roster. Fails with a clear conflict error when the role already exists (check list_org_positions active_only=false first — a deactivated role should be reactivated with update_org_position is_active=true, not re-created). Requires org admin. Nobody is notified.

tools_if_shown.name: update_org_position
tools_if_shown.description: Rename, reorder, re-rate, deactivate (is_active=false), or reactivate (is_active=true) an organization position. position_id is the org position id from list_org_positions (pass active_only=false to see deactivated roles). Name/section edits apply to custom roles only; catalog roles keep their catalog name. Deactivated roles stop being offered for staffing but keep their history. Requires org admin. Nobody is notified.

tools_if_shown.name: list_crew_offers
tools_if_shown.description: List crew offers. scope="mine" (default) is the recipient-side view: offers sent to you (or user_id), filtered by status. scope="organization" lists the organization's shifts on each gig's Staffing board, including DRAFT ones that apply_calllist_to_event or create_crew_offer created but nobody has been sent yet; each row carries status (DRAFT, OPEN, FILLED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED), offer_type, event_id, org_position_id, days, and recipients with their per-person status. Filter organization rows by status, type, event_id, or a from/to civil-day window (YYYY-MM-DD). Read-only; organization scope is for org members only.

tools_if_shown.name: get_crew_offer
tools_if_shown.description: Get one crew offer (shift) with its days and every recipient (user_id, status, fee, delivery). Use before send_crew_offer to review who is attached, and after to confirm delivery. Read-only; org members only.

tools_if_shown.name: review_staffing_draft
tools_if_shown.description: Review a gig's staffing board before anything is sent: every shift grouped by position, with title, days and call times (in the gig's timezone), fee, seats_needed / max_acceptances, each day's spots and accepted count, and status, each attached person's name with their status, fee and delivery, and seat counts (needed vs attached vs accepted; an open shift needs its busiest day's spots). Flags the shifts that still have people nobody has sent anything to (sendable). Read-only and sends nothing; to send a shift call send_crew_offer (confirmation-gated). Org members only.

tools_if_shown.name: create_crew_offer
tools_if_shown.description: Create a DRAFT shift on a gig's Staffing board by hand (the alternative to apply_calllist_to_event). Give it a title, the event_id, the org_position_id it staffs (from list_org_positions — create one first with create_org_position if the roster is empty), a single date or explicit days[], call times, and a fee. offer_type JOB_OFFER (default) targets named people and fills seats_needed; OPEN_SHIFT is a first-to-accept broadcast capped by max_acceptances. recipient_ids / recipients attach people as UNSENT draft recipients (both spellings are merged; recipients[] adds a per-person fee). NOTHING IS SENT AND NOBODY IS NOTIFIED by this tool — review with get_crew_offer, then send_crew_offer (gated) sends it. Org members with gig-operations access.

tools_if_shown.name: update_crew_offer
tools_if_shown.description: Edit a shift: title, description, date or days[], call times, fee/fee_type/currency, seats_needed or max_acceptances, expires_at, and (while still DRAFT) the attached recipients — recipient_ids and/or recipients[] (per-person fees) are merged into one full set to keep; anyone omitted from that set is dropped. Pass start_time or end_time as "" to clear the offer-level time. Per-day overrides: day_fees[{date, fee}] (fee 0 clears), day_seats[{date, seats_needed}] (0 clears), day_times[{date, start_time, end_time}]. Days that already passed cannot change times. Editing does not notify anyone; to withdraw or send a shift use the dedicated flows (send_crew_offer to send). Org members with gig-operations access.

tools_if_shown.name: add_external_crew_member
tools_if_shown.description: Add someone who has no Soundcheck account (an outside singer on a personal email, a sub engineer, a phone-only contact) to a shift. Give first_name and email. phone_number and sms_consent (true only when that person agreed to texts) are optional, and company shows on the roster. On a DRAFT shift they are attached unsent; on an OPEN or FILLED shift they are emailed a link to accept or decline without signing up, so that call is confirmation-gated. Org members with gig-operations access.

tools_if_shown.name: update_shift_recipient
tools_if_shown.description: Set one person's own call details on one shift: sound check time, special instructions, leader role (MUSIC_DIRECTOR, MC or LEADER; one holder per role per gig), act unit and lead, and per-day call windows or day notes. Pass only what changes; null clears a field. A pending or accepted person is sent an update when a value really changes. Call times on an hourly shift are the pay, so day windows are refused there. Org members with gig-operations access.

tools_if_shown.name: swap_shift_recipient
tools_if_shown.description: Replace one live person on a shift with another in one request. The replacement is added first and gets the offer email with the outgoing person's days; then the outgoing person is removed and gets a cancellation. Give remove_user_id and exactly one of add_user_id (an org member) or add_person (first_name, email, and optional phone, consent and company). A PENDING or STANDBY person needs gig-operations access; removing an accepted person needs finance access. If the add lands but the removal fails the response is SWAP_PARTIAL with both ids, so no seat is lost. Confirmation-gated: it messages two people.

tools_if_shown.name: send_crew_offer
tools_if_shown.description: Send a shift to crew: flips a DRAFT to OPEN and notifies recipients by email/SMS/push. Omit recipient_ids/recipients to send to the recipients already attached (or the linked call list); pass them to add or target specific people. recipients[] carries per-person fees for people this send ADDS and its user_ids are sent too (no need to repeat them in recipient_ids); a fee for someone already attached is refused here — set it with update_crew_offer first. The confirmation token binds the exact people who will be notified (named plus already attached) and their fees, so attaching someone or changing a fee after approval re-gates the send. Re-sending an OPEN shift reaches newly added people and attached PENDING recipients whose delivery status is NOT_SENT (the tool refuses a no-op send and says so); use send_reminder kind=crew_offer for nudges. To ask someone who declined again, name them in recipient_ids and pass reask_dates with the day or days to re-ask. With no recipients given, the current members of the linked call list are resolved now and sent by id. Messages real people, so it is confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set — the confirmation summary names the shift and who will be notified.

tools_if_shown.name: list_ledger_accounts
tools_if_shown.description: List the organization's ledger accounts (value = account id, label, type income|expense). create_ledger_item needs an income account for INCOME/RECEIVABLE items and an expense account for EXPENSE/PAYABLE items; it resolves the account automatically when the org has exactly one of that type, otherwise pass account_id from this list. Read-only.

tools_if_shown.name: create_ledger_item
tools_if_shown.description: Add a line to a gig's finances, as the GUI Finances tab does: ledger_type INCOME (money received), RECEIVABLE (an invoice/what a client owes), EXPENSE (money spent), or PAYABLE (a cost or payout still owed — set counterparty_user_id or counterparty_name). amount is positive in the item's currency (default USD); date is the civil day YYYY-MM-DD. account_id is resolved automatically when the org has one account of the matching type; otherwise pick one from list_ledger_accounts. Bookkeeping only: no money moves and no email is sent. INCOME and EXPENSE are created PAID and cannot then be edited with update_ledger_item; RECEIVABLE and PAYABLE start UNPAID. To log a cost or income that has not changed hands yet, use PAYABLE or RECEIVABLE. Use record_ledger_payment for payments already made outside Soundcheck; settle_event only closes the gig after payouts are settled and does not pay lines. Members see only items involving them; admins/owners see all.

tools_if_shown.name: update_ledger_item
tools_if_shown.description: Edit an UNPAID ledger line (amount, description, date, currency, counterparty, assignee, tax, notes, account_id, ledger_type). Pass counterparty_user_id, assigned_to_user_id, counterparty_name, or notes as "" to clear them. Paid or settled lines cannot be edited — void_ledger_item and create a corrected line instead. ledger_item_id comes from get_event_ledger. No money moves and nobody is notified.

tools_if_shown.name: void_ledger_item
tools_if_shown.description: Void a ledger line so it no longer counts toward the gig totals or settlement (the row stays for the audit trail; it is not deleted). Use for mistaken or cancelled invoices and payouts. Only UNPAID lines can be voided; PAID lines, including newly created INCOME and EXPENSE lines, are refused. Cannot be undone and changes the outstanding balance, so it is confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Owner, Admin or Finance only.

tools_if_shown.name: record_ledger_payment
tools_if_shown.description: Record a payment that was made OUTSIDE Soundcheck (cash, check, Zelle, Venmo, PayPal, wire, other) against a payout or invoice on a gig. A payment that covers the remaining balance marks the line PAID; a smaller one leaves status UNPAID, and the returned line shows payment_status partial with paid_amount and remaining_amount. Does not move money — card and bank payouts stay in the Soundcheck app. Omit amount to record the full remaining balance; paid_on defaults to today and cannot be in the future. ledger_item_id comes from get_event_ledger. Only the org owner, a Finance member, or a member with finance access can record against any line; crew can record only their own payout. Undo with reverse_ledger_payment. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: reverse_ledger_payment
tools_if_shown.description: Undo the most recent payment recorded outside Soundcheck on a ledger line (one recorded with record_ledger_payment or the app's Mark as paid). The line returns to UNPAID or its earlier partially-paid balance; the reversal stays on the audit trail. Only manual payments can be reversed — card/Stripe payments need a refund in the app. Does not move money. Only the org owner, a Finance member, or a member with finance access can reverse any line; crew only a payment they recorded on their own payout. Each call reverses one more payment, so it is confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: update_venue
tools_if_shown.description: Edit your organization's copy of a venue as the GUI venue page does: name, address, latitude/longitude, phone_number, website, notes, capacity, load_in/load_out, parking, dock, elevator, wifi, venue_type, dressing_rooms, green_room, contact_*, restrictions[], amenities[]. Edits stay inside your organization; other organizations that saved the same venue keep their own copy. photo_url and place_id describe the shared directory listing. stage_size and house_tech[] belong to stages: prefer save_venue_stage; sent here they land on the venue's first stage. Pass just the fields to change — omitted fields are untouched; an explicit empty string clears a text field and an explicit null clears capacity, dressing_rooms, or green_room (name cannot be blank; latitude/longitude can be set but not cleared — the API keeps the stored coordinates when they are omitted or null). Your organization's private notes, status, metadata, and access code live on the overlay — use update_venue_org_details for those (kept separate so each call is one atomic write). Errors if no field is given. Requires CRM-manager access. Verify with get_venue.

tools_if_shown.name: update_venue_org_details
tools_if_shown.description: Edit your organization's private overlay on a venue: org_notes (notes only your org sees), org_status (your status label), org_metadata (free-form), and access_code (door/gate code). The shared venue record is untouched — use update_venue for that. Pass just the fields to change; an explicit empty string clears a text field. Errors if no field is given. One atomic write. Requires CRM-manager access. Verify with get_venue.

tools_if_shown.name: save_customer
tools_if_shown.description: Create or edit a customer (client/contact) in an organization, as the GUI CRM form does. Without customer_id this creates one: name is required. With customer_id (from list_customers) it edits that customer: pass just the fields to change — omitted fields are untouched, an explicit empty string clears a text field, a blank name is rejected, and it errors if no field is given. Requires CRM-manager access. Returns the customer; verify edits with get_customer.

tools_if_shown.name: save_sponsor
tools_if_shown.description: Create or edit a sponsor in an organization, as the GUI CRM form does. Without sponsor_id this creates one: name is required. With sponsor_id (from list_sponsors) it edits that sponsor: pass just the fields to change — omitted fields are untouched, an explicit empty string clears a text field, a blank name is rejected, and it errors if no field is given. Requires CRM-manager access. Returns the sponsor; verify edits with list_sponsors.

tools_if_shown.name: remove_event_member
tools_if_shown.description: Take one or more people (by user id) off a gig's roster, as the GUI Manage Team remove does. Side effects: their pending invitations for the gig are cleared and they are dropped from the gig's calendar event. NOT done for you (see ENG-494): an UNPAID payable for them stays on get_event_ledger (void_ledger_item if it should not be paid) and any crew offer they accepted stays as-is (check list_crew_offers scope=organization). Removing a person does not notify them. Because it alters staffing and leaves money to reconcile, it is confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Requires gig-operations access. Verify with list_event_members.

tools_if_shown.name: reply_to_mailbox_thread
tools_if_shown.description: Message the people on an organization mailbox thread — the close-the-loop reply the GUI Mailbox lacks. kind + thread_id identify the thread from list_mailbox: INVITATION (thread_id = event_id), CREW_OFFER (offer_id), or AVAILABILITY_REQUEST (request_id). recipients picks who gets it: pending (default — people who have not answered), responded (accepted/declined, or available/unavailable on availability threads), or all; user_ids narrows further. The reply goes by channel SMS (sms_body) or EMAIL (email_subject + email_body) through the same delivery as send_message, tagged to the thread's gig. Only recipients with a Soundcheck user id can be reached (external email-only invitees are skipped). Messages real people, so it is confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set — the summary states exactly how many people will be messaged.

tools_if_shown.name: list_venue_stages
tools_if_shown.description: List the bookable stages, rooms or spaces your organization has set up at its venues (Main Stage, Side Room, Patio…). Each stage has id, venue_id, venue_name, name, capacity, notes, stage_size, house_tech, latitude/longitude (its map pin), and sort_order. Stages are private to your organization. Pass venue_id to list one venue's stages. Use the stage ids with set_event_stages, check_venue_stage_conflicts and list_venue_stage_bookings.

tools_if_shown.name: save_venue_stage
tools_if_shown.description: Add or edit a bookable stage, room or space at a venue. Without stage_id this adds one: name is required, names must be unique per venue (409 STAGE_NAME_TAKEN), a venue holds up to 50 stages, and the venue is saved to your organization's directory if it is not already. With stage_id (from list_venue_stages) it edits that stage: pass just the fields to change among name, capacity, notes, stage_size, house_tech, latitude/longitude, or archived (true hides it from pickers but keeps past bookings; false restores it). Requires CRM-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: delete_venue_stage
tools_if_shown.description: Permanently delete a venue stage that has no gigs booked on it. A stage with bookings answers 409 STAGE_HAS_BOOKINGS — archive it instead with save_venue_stage archived=true, which keeps its history. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set.

tools_if_shown.name: set_event_stages
tools_if_shown.description: Book a gig onto one or more stages at its venue. stage_ids is the FULL set (it replaces the current stages); pass [] to clear. Every stage must be an active stage at the gig's linked venue (link the venue first with link_venue_to_event), else 400 STAGE_NOT_AT_EVENT_VENUE. Overlaps never block the booking: the response lists stage_conflicts (other gigs on the same stage at an overlapping time). Always tell the user about any conflicts. Requires gig-operations access.

tools_if_shown.name: check_venue_stage_conflicts
tools_if_shown.description: Check whether stages are free for a date and time before booking, for example "is Main Stage free on Oct 10 from 8pm to 11pm". Returns conflicts: the gigs already on those stages at an overlapping time (drafts included; cancelled and archived gigs ignored). Without start_time the whole day is checked. Pass exclude_event_id when re-checking a gig that is already booked. Nothing is written.

tools_if_shown.name: list_venue_stage_bookings
tools_if_shown.description: List gigs booked on stages between two days (at most 92 days apart), one row per gig and stage, with start, end, all_day and conflict_event_ids (other gigs overlapping on the same stage). Cancelled and archived gigs are left out unless include_cancelled is true. Pass venue_id to limit to one venue. Use it to answer "what is on the Side Room next week" or to spot double-bookings.

tools_if_shown.name: enrich_venue
tools_if_shown.description: Research a venue on the web (via context.dev) and return a PROPOSAL of venue details and stages: capacity, venue type, stage size, load-in/out, dock, elevator, parking, wifi, dressing rooms, green room, house tech, amenities, restrictions, published booking contact, plus the stages or rooms the venue books separately. Each value carries a source_url and a short evidence excerpt. NOTHING is written. Show the proposal to the user, and only after they confirm apply what they choose with update_venue (venue fields) and save_venue_stage (stages, including stage_size and house_tech). The same venue is cached for 24 hours and each organization has a daily limit. Returns 503 ENRICHMENT_UNAVAILABLE when research is not configured, and 422 VENUE_IDENTITY_MISSING when the venue has neither an address nor a website.

tools_if_shown.name: list_projects
tools_if_shown.description: List your organization's projects (tours, festivals, residencies, runs of gigs): id, name, status, dates, client and gig counts. Flights and hotel stays belong to a project, so use these ids with the project flight and hotel tools. Every gig also has one owning project (get_event returns its project_id); one-gig projects made automatically for single gigs are left out unless include_implicit is true. Returns up to limit projects (default 100, max 500); when next_cursor is set, pass it back as cursor for the next page.

tools_if_shown.name: get_event_travel
tools_if_shown.description: Read the flights and hotel stays that cover one gig, across its projects. Returns { flights, hotels }. Each flight has id, project_id, project_name, airline, flight_number, depart_airport, arrive_airport, depart_at/depart_timezone, arrive_at/arrive_timezone, booking_reference, cost/cost_currency (only with financial access), notes, event_ids (the gigs it covers) and passengers (id, user_id, user_name, confirmation_code, seat, ticket_number, baggage_count, notes). Crew members see only their own passenger and guest rows. Read-only.

tools_if_shown.name: list_project_travel
tools_if_shown.description: List the flights and hotel stays recorded on a project. Returns { flights, hotels }; kind="flights" or kind="hotels" returns just that list. Each flight has id, project_id, project_name, airline, flight_number, depart_airport, arrive_airport, depart_at/depart_timezone, arrive_at/arrive_timezone, booking_reference, cost/cost_currency (only with financial access), notes, event_ids (the gigs it covers) and passengers (id, user_id, user_name, confirmation_code, seat, ticket_number, baggage_count, notes). Each stay has id, project_id, project_name, hotel_id, hotel_name, check_in_date, check_out_date, confirmation_number, room_count, notes, event_ids (the gigs it covers) and guests (id, user_id, user_name, room_number, confirmation_number, notes). Requires project-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: create_project_flight
tools_if_shown.description: Record a flight leg on a project. Every field is optional, but give at least the airline, flight number, airports and times you know. Instants need an offset and each end gets its airport's IATA zone. Pass event_id or event_ids with the gig so get_event_travel lists it. Add travellers afterwards with save_flight_passenger. This records a booking made elsewhere; it books nothing. Requires project-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: update_project_flight
tools_if_shown.description: Edit a recorded flight leg. Pass just the fields to change; null clears a field. event_ids replaces the covered gigs. Changing cost needs financial access. Requires project-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: delete_project_flight
tools_if_shown.description: Permanently delete a recorded flight leg and its passenger rows. It cancels nothing with the airline. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Requires project-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: save_flight_passenger
tools_if_shown.description: Put a member of your organization on a recorded flight leg, or edit their row. Without passenger_id this adds user_id (from list_users; a person can be on a leg once) with their own confirmation code, seat, ticket number and bags. With passenger_id (passengers[].id, not user_id) it edits that row: pass just the fields to change; null clears. Returns the whole flight. Passports and frequent-flyer numbers stay on the person profile and are not set here. Requires project-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: remove_flight_passenger
tools_if_shown.description: Take a traveller off a recorded flight leg. Returns the whole flight. It cancels nothing with the airline. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Requires project-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: create_project_hotel
tools_if_shown.description: Record a hotel stay (a room block) on a project. hotel_id comes from search_hotels; when the property is not there, add it with create_hotel first. Pass event_id or event_ids with the gig so get_event_travel lists it. Assign rooms afterwards with save_hotel_guest. This records a booking made elsewhere; it books nothing. Requires project-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: update_project_hotel
tools_if_shown.description: Edit a recorded hotel stay: hotel_id (move it to another property), dates, confirmation_number, room_count, notes or event_ids. Pass just the fields to change; null clears. Requires project-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: delete_project_hotel
tools_if_shown.description: Permanently delete a recorded hotel stay and its room assignments. It cancels nothing with the hotel. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Requires project-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: save_hotel_guest
tools_if_shown.description: Assign a member of your organization to a recorded hotel stay, or edit their room assignment. Without guest_id this adds user_id (from list_users) with room number, their own confirmation number and notes. With guest_id (guests[].id, not user_id) it edits that row: pass just the fields to change; null clears. Returns the whole stay. Requires project-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: remove_hotel_guest
tools_if_shown.description: Take a guest off a recorded hotel stay. Returns the whole stay. It cancels nothing with the hotel. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Requires project-manager access.

tools_if_shown.name: search_hotels
tools_if_shown.description: Search the hotel directory by name, brand, website, address or amenity (up to 50 matches). Each hotel has id, name, address, phone_number, website, brand, check-in/out times, and is_saved_for_org; negotiated rates only show with financial access. Use the id as hotel_id on create_project_hotel. When nothing matches, add the property with create_hotel.

tools_if_shown.name: create_hotel
tools_if_shown.description: Add a hotel to the directory so a stay can be recorded there. Search with search_hotels first to avoid duplicates. Returns the hotel with its id. Requires gig-operations access.

tools_if_shown.name: get_event_run_of_show
tools_if_shown.description: Read the full Run of Show document for a gig (sections, items, cues, song lists) including version for optimistic edits. Use expected_version from this response with update_event_run_of_show. Prefer this over get_event_schedule when the org adopted Run of Show. Event participants can read.

tools_if_shown.name: create_event_schedule_items
tools_if_shown.description: Add timeline rows to a gig that still uses the legacy schedule (not Run of Show). Each item needs name and start_time as RFC3339 with offset. Returns the full schedule. Orgs that adopted Run of Show respond 409 RUN_OF_SHOW_ADOPTED — use update_event_run_of_show instead. Gig managers only.

tools_if_shown.name: upsert_event_schedule
tools_if_shown.description: Replace the entire legacy gig timeline: PUT sends the full schedule_items list and any existing row whose id is omitted is deleted. Times are RFC3339 with offset. Orgs that adopted Run of Show respond 409 RUN_OF_SHOW_ADOPTED — use update_event_run_of_show. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Gig managers only.

tools_if_shown.name: update_event_run_of_show
tools_if_shown.description: Replace the full Run of Show document for a gig in an org that adopted Run of Show: sections, items, cues, and song lists. Pass expected_version from the current run-of-show GET (version field alongside sections/items). Times use RFC3339 with offset. Set allow_empty=true only to clear a previously non-empty show. Items may be sent back as the GET returned them: their songs and document_attachments become song_ids and document_ids. song_lists_complete defaults to true unless an existing item has neither song_ids nor songs. Returns 412 when expected_version is stale. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Run-of-show editors only.

tools_if_shown.name: list_music_requests
tools_if_shown.description: List the music request lists the clients and staff filled in for a gig (the Music requests form). Returns each submission with its song-list rows grouped by category, the guidance notes, whether the client can still revise (can_revise) and the last day they can (editable_through, null when there is no end or the gig was removed), and per-category counts. Library match (In library, Possible match, Not in library) and library song ids are returned only to organization members.

tools_if_shown.name: check_music_request_warnings
tools_if_shown.description: Check a gig's run-of-show songs against its do-not-play requests. Returns each warning (the run-of-show item, the song, and the rule it matched) and any genre rules that cannot be checked against the library. Warnings do not block saving the run of show.

tools_if_shown.name: update_form_submission_answers
tools_if_shown.description: Replace the answers to named questions on a form submission (for example the song list) on the client's behalf. Only the questions you name change; the rest are kept. Each song_list value replaces that question's rows, and duplicate rows are refused. Requires crm.manage and the client-portal-forms flag.

tools_if_shown.name: create_form_submission_for_assignment
tools_if_shown.description: Enter answers to a form assignment on the client's behalf when the client has not answered yet (for example, a music request list from a phone call). Required questions may be left out. Fails with SUBMISSION_EXISTS when the assignment already has an answer; use update_form_submission_answers then. No notification is sent. Requires crm.manage and the client-portal-forms flag.

tools_if_shown.name: set_form_assignment_editable_until
tools_if_shown.description: Set the last day (YYYY-MM-DD, in the gig's time zone) on which the client can revise the answers to a form assignment. The day only bounds revisions: the client's first answer is always accepted. The day applies even when it falls after the gig. From the next day the client sees a locked response and the stored answers do not change. Pass null to follow the gig: the answers stay revisable until the gig is over, or at any time when the assignment has no gig. Staff can always edit. Requires crm.manage and the client-portal-forms flag.

tools_if_shown.name: list_show_contacts
tools_if_shown.description: List a gig's advance contacts: the outside people on the show that are not crew — venue GM and production manager, promoter rep, house electrician, union steward, box office, hospitality, catering, runners. Each has id, role, name, company, phone, email, notes and sort_order. Anyone on the gig can read them; phone and email are returned only to callers who manage the gig.

tools_if_shown.name: save_show_contact
tools_if_shown.description: Add or edit a person in a gig's advance contact directory (venue, promoter, union, vendor). Without contact_id this adds a contact: pass at least a role or a name. With contact_id (from list_show_contacts) it edits that contact: pass only the fields to change; null or "" clears a field. These are not crew and receive no invitation or message. Requires gig-operations access.

tools_if_shown.name: remove_show_contact
tools_if_shown.description: Remove a person from a gig's contact directory. Confirmation-gated when MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET is set. Requires gig-operations access.

tools_if_shown.name: list_event_links
tools_if_shown.description: List a gig's web links: the event page it was imported from, ticket and RSVP pages, the organizer site, community and online join links, and links people added. Each has id, label, url, kind, position and source (IMPORT rows were written by an event-link import and are replaced when the page is imported again; MANUAL rows were added or edited by a person). Anyone on the gig can read them.
